Exclusion Criteria:
  -  azoospermia
  -  smoke
  -  use drugs
  -  use drugs  [AND] with proven fertility toxicity
  -  exposition to any environmental  [OR] or occupational toxic substances
  -  exposition to radiation  [OR] or heat
  -  orchitis secondary to mumps
  -  sexually transmitted diseases
  -  history of cryptorchidism
  -  previous testicular torsion
  -  genitourinary anomalies
  -  alterations of the epididymis  [OR] or deferens
  -  inguinal surgery
